title: The carved front door
caption: Daksina Bhawan, from the street.
note: You can tell it is the right place from the doorway: carved, warm, like walking into an old family house.
alt: The front of Daksina Bhawan South Indian Restaurant: a gabled porch with a tiled roof and teal scalloped trim over the name sign, a carved wooden frieze with three round medallions above a pair of wooden doors with glowing glass panels, carved peacocks on the pillars either side, tall potted palms, a white wrought-iron chair and table on green turf, and a standing sign with a painted dancer's face, on a wet brick pavement

title: Under the temple bells
caption: Brass temple bells hang over the dining room.
note: I looked up and smiled at all those bells.
alt: A narrow dining room with a dark wooden ceiling hung with rows of brass temple bells, a carved wooden staircase on the left, an arched mural of a South Indian temple tower with palms and an elephant at the far end, and cushioned booths along a panelled wall

title: A dosa, folded in half
caption: A crisp dosa, with sambar and chutneys.
note: The benne dosa is my favourite thing here: crisp on the outside, soft in the middle.
alt: A crisp golden dosa folded in half on a round hammered steel plate, with small steel bowls of sambar and red, white and green chutneys beside it, seen from above on a dark wooden table

title: The temple on the wall
caption: A temple painted on the wall, under a ceiling of bells.
note: The painted temple at the far end of the room feels like a window to somewhere else.
alt: A tall arched wall mural of a colourful South Indian temple tower beside banana and coconut palms, a lotus pond in front and an elephant with a rider at the right, with brass bells hanging from a wooden grid ceiling above and booths below

title: Blinds over the murals
caption: Soft murals behind half-drawn blinds.
note: A calm corner of the room, with painted scenes glowing behind the blinds.
alt: Two woven reddish blinds half drawn over backlit sepia murals of palms, riverside temple steps and a tree, with a brass lantern between them, and cane-backed wooden chairs and tables with menus below

title: Lanterns on a panelled wall
caption: Brass lanterns on a panelled wall.
note: Warm light from small brass lanterns, and the whole room feels homely.
alt: A tall cream wall with dark wood moulded panels, a row of glowing brass lanterns, carved wooden squares set on the diagonal, and a wooden slatted ceiling above, with booths and tables at the bottom

title: Up the wooden stairs
caption: The wooden staircase under the bells.
note: Even the staircase feels like it belongs in an old family house.
alt: A carved wooden staircase with turned balusters and carved posts climbing to a small upper level under a ceiling of hanging brass bells, with part of the temple mural and a wall lamp at the right

title: The house on the hill
caption: A tiny hill with one house lit from inside.
note: Someone built a whole hillside and then left a light on in one little house.
alt: A hand-made miniature hill in greens, teal and rust, with a small timber house with a red roof and softly glowing windows, and a thin curved road winding round it; plants and a black planter stand behind it on a desk

title: Signed on the back
caption: The back of the hill, signed by the artist.
note: Turn it over and it tells you who made it: Aslam Khan, 19/7/26.
alt: A hand holding the back of a small wooden panel, dark and textured with pale crusted growth, with a white paper label reading Aslam Khan 19/7/26 in one corner and handwriting along the bottom edge

title: A lamp over the pothos
caption: One small lamp, one pothos, and everything else in the dark.
note: I like this corner best in the dark, with just one small lamp over the plant.
alt: A pothos plant lit from above by a small white lamp in a pitch-black room, its heart-shaped leaves glowing yellow-green with a few brown patches

title: Under the blossom ceiling
caption: Under a ceiling of pink blossom.
note: I kept looking up at the ceiling. It makes an ordinary dinner feel like a special night.
alt: A restaurant dining room under a thick ceiling of pink blossom, with red leather booths, gold lattice screens and a lit bar at the back

title: Two glasses, one dim table
caption: Two drinks at a dim table.
note: One drink dark with chocolate, the other glowing like a lamp. Dinner already felt like a treat.
alt: Two tall glasses with paper straws on white napkins: a creamy drink streaked with chocolate and an amber iced drink, in warm dim light

title: Soup, sauces and something crisp
caption: Soup, sauces and something crisp, in low sun.
note: The warm light made everything on the table look cosy.
alt: A dark table from above: two black bowls of orange soup with coriander and cherry tomatoes on a P.F. Chang's napkin, a tray of three chilli sauces, and a long dish of crisp glazed batons with peas

title: Spring rolls, cut open
caption: Spring rolls, cut open.
note: The spring rolls were the first thing I wanted to dig into.
alt: Four crisp spring rolls cut in half on a square black plate, with a small black bowl of dark chilli dipping sauce beside them

title: Noodles with a crown of crispy garlic
caption: Noodles under a crown of crispy garlic.
note: I went straight for the crispy garlic on top.
alt: A black bowl of stir-fried noodles with green beans, carrot and cabbage, covered in golden crispy garlic, with a serving spoon and fork resting in it

title: Twirled and glazed
caption: Twirled and glazed.
note: Shiny, warm and gone far too quickly.
alt: A swirl of golden noodles with sticky glazed pieces and spring onion on a dark speckled stone plate, with another plate blurred behind

title: A fortune, half out
caption: A fortune cookie, with the fortune half out.
note: A little fortune to end the dinner, and I smiled.
alt: A hand holding a cracked fortune cookie with a small paper slip showing, in a dim restaurant with a blurred table and diner behind

title: Durga Maa, for Navratri
caption: Durga Maa, lit up for Navratri.
note: A pandal inside a mall was unexpected, but Maa Durga looked beautiful and it made the whole place feel festive.
alt: A large white idol of the goddess Durga with many raised arms, standing on a lion above a buffalo, with four smaller figures around her including Ganesha, in front of a white lace-like arch and between two golden patterned screens, on a round stage ringed with light behind red rope barriers and potted plants, in a mall atrium

title: Flowers at the crossing
caption: Orchids and chrysanthemums in the middle of the mall.
note: Flowers in the middle of a mall make you slow down for a minute.
alt: A round table with a twisting rose-gold base holding tall white vases of pink orchids, green and magenta chrysanthemums, ringed by black pots of variegated green plants on a polished marble floor, with shop fronts and hanging festive decorations in the mall behind

title: A wall of mural and mirrors
caption: The coffee mural wall at Costa.
note: I like how much this wall tells you about coffee before you have even ordered.
alt: A long café wall of cream plaster under a terracotta ceiling with black track lights and round white globe lamps, holding a large framed mural in red and orange, two tall oval mirrors edged with yellow light, wooden chairs with plum seats, a brown leather bench and a planter of green leaves, with a tray of red Costa cups on a table at the right

title: Coffee, from bean to cup
caption: Coffee, drawn from bean to cup.
note: I stood close and followed the whole story of coffee along the wall.
alt: A close view of a framed wall mural in red, pink and orange showing a coffee plant with a white blossom and berries, a large circle of coffee beans, a roasting machine with a small seated figure holding a cup, and curling steam, beside a round white lamp under a terracotta ceiling

title: Serene caramel frappe
caption: The serene caramel frappe, held up against the mural.
note: Costa's signature serene caramel frappe. The coffee is great.
alt: A hand holding a tall red and pale blue paper cup marked COLD COFFEE, topped with whipped cream and caramel under a clear dome lid, in front of a colourful coffee mural and a brown leather booth

title: A slice of cheesecake
caption: A slice of cheesecake.
note: Smooth, creamy and simple. The cheesecake is good too.
alt: A triangular slice of plain baked cheesecake with a pale golden top and a biscuit crumb base, on a gold cake board on a beige tray

title: A camera, a cup and an old newspaper
caption: An illustrated camera and cup at NY United Cafe.
note: Seen at NY United Cafe, on the ground floor of my office. It looks like a morning from another decade.
alt: An illustration seen from above of a pale green and maroon film camera on a folded newspaper, a white cup of amber drink on a saucer, and a small instant photograph, on a blue wooden table with chipped orange paint

title: A heart in the foam
caption: A painted latte with a heart in the foam.
note: Another one from NY United Cafe, downstairs at my office: thick, bright brushstrokes and a small heart in the foam.
alt: A thickly painted picture of a cup of coffee on a saucer with a heart in the foam and steam rising, against swirling brushstrokes of orange, gold and deep blue

title: The emptiest metro
caption: A Delhi Metro platform, almost empty, the day the gates were shut.
note: 10 October 2026. Entry and exit gates were closed at 45 stations for a protest in central Delhi, and the platforms emptied. I was on my way from Delhi to Gurugram, and it was the first time I had seen a Delhi metro station this empty.
alt: A long, almost empty Delhi Metro platform under a slatted wooden ceiling, with closed glass platform doors on the right, a steel pillar wrapped in a line map and a sign reading Platform 1 towards Botanical Garden, a floor striped in pink and green with yellow tactile paving, and one passenger sitting on a round bench at the left edge

title: Two figures in charcoal
caption: A charcoal drawing by my friend Dr. Nishant.
note: My friend Dr. Nishant is a psychologist and an artist at heart. I took this photo when we met in Delhi.
alt: A charcoal drawing on bright pink paper of two figures in a close embrace seen from behind, one with dark curly hair, signed with a bold N at the lower right, in a spiral-bound sketchbook held up by a hand in a dimly lit room

title: Samosa chaat, in a paper bowl
caption: The samosa chaat at NY United Cafe.
note: It is so tasty. This is the café on the ground floor of my office, where my usual order is the walking taco and chai.
alt: A hand holding a white paper bowl of samosa chaat with a wooden spoon: pieces of samosa and chickpeas under curd, red sauce, chopped onion, coriander and a heap of fine sev, with a menu board showing burgers and omelettes behind

title: Love is in the air
caption: A heart in the clouds above my office.
note: 28 September 2026. The weather turned beautiful out of nowhere, and then a heart appeared in the sky above my office. It looked so romantic. Love is in the air, quite literally.
alt: A heart-shaped patch of dark blue cloud among white and grey clouds, above the glass towers of an office park with an Urbana sign, over a plaza with potted trees, hoardings and a few people walking

title: The one thing between me and my six pecs
caption: Chole bhature with sweet lassi, from Pind Bhaturas.
note: I love chole bhature so much that I order them every Sunday. I cannot say no to them at all. This one is from Pind Bhaturas in Gurugram, where I always order from, and it is so good, so tastyyyy. The one thing standing between me and my six pecs.
alt: A round steel plate seen from above with two golden puffed bhature, a glass bowl of dark chole with a spoon, a black bowl of sliced onions and peppers, a small tub of green chutney, and a hand holding a tall bottle of sweet lassi, on a grey blanket

title: Batman, on guard at my desk
caption: My crocheted Batman, on duty.
note: My sister gave me this wool Batman when I was on a trip in Jaipur. I have always been a huge Batman fan, and she knows it. Now he stays with me at the office, on my desk, all the time.
alt: A small crocheted Batman doll in a dark cowl with white eyes, a pale yellow face, a grey body and a yellow belt, standing on the keyboard of an open laptop whose screen shows a Batman lock-screen wallpaper with a red bat symbol and the time 17:18

title: Veni, vidi, vici
caption: Caesar's three words, tattooed.
note: My recent tattoo: veni, vidi, vici, the famous line from Julius Caesar. It means "I came, I saw, I conquered." I am trying to bring that line into my life, conquering and achieving everything I long for.
alt: A pencil-shaded close-up of the side of a person's neck below the ear, with a small tattoo of the words VENI written downwards and VIDI and VICI written across it, forming a cross with leaf-tipped arrows at each end

title: The verandah, after dark
caption: Shikarbagh, lit up after dark.
note: Fairy lights all along the verandah. The ambience at Shikarbagh is so good, especially at night.
alt: A long verandah at night under a cream canopy printed with small elephants, its edge covered in green vines strung with fairy lights, with lanterns glowing by wooden glass doors and large yellow planters along a stone-paved walkway

title: Lanterns in the garden
caption: The garden seating at Shikarbagh.
note: The garden at night, under strings of lights.
alt: A gravel garden dining area at night with strings of round bulbs overhead, green lanterns glowing with a warm flame light along a wooden slatted fence, black metal chairs and tables, a few people standing in the distance and tall trees behind

title: The fountain, in absolute dark
caption: Taken in absolute dark, thanks to my iPhone 17 Pro.
note: It looks lit from every side, but it was taken in absolute dark. Thanks, iPhone 17 Pro.
alt: A tiered cream stone fountain in a round pool edged with blue mosaic tiles, a thin jet of water rising through the leaves of a large tree, with cream tent canopies, a gravel yard and a glowing lamp behind, all looking brightly lit although the scene was almost completely dark

title: Dinner under the canopy
caption: The tented dining area at Shikarbagh.
note: A tented dining area, busy with an evening crowd.
alt: A tented dining area at night with a ceiling printed with gold elephants and palm trees, wall fans and lanterns on pale green posts, people eating at wooden tables, and a green ice bucket on a dark wooden cabinet in the foreground

title: The courtyard fountain
caption: A fountain in the courtyard, after dark.
note: Shikarbagh is inside Hotel Narain Niwas Palace in Rambagh, Jaipur. It is also where I met my bhabhi in person for the first time.
alt: A cobbled courtyard at night with a lit fountain in a round pool, a warmly lit palace building with arched windows behind it, low pavilions with strings of lamps on either side, parked cars, a palm tree and two people standing by the fountain

title: Creamy pasta and garlic bread
caption: Pasta and garlic bread at Shikarbagh.
note: We ordered so much food and drinks here, and all of it was so good.
alt: A wide white bowl of creamy penne with broccoli and chopped herbs, with a slice of toasted garlic bread on the rim and a dark spoon, on a dimly lit table with an empty plate behind

title: Peach and lemon mocktail
caption: The peach and lemon mocktail.
note: The drinks were good too: a peach and lemon mocktail.
alt: A hand with a black-strapped watch holding a tall glass of orange-pink mocktail with two paper straws, on a dimly lit restaurant table with a plate and glasses behind

title: Peach iced tea and cold coffee
caption: Peach iced tea and cold coffee at Punjab Grill.
note: A cold, refreshing peach iced tea and a cold coffee next to a heavy Punjabi meal. The food was crazy good.
alt: Two tall glasses on a wooden table: a peach iced tea with a thick pale foam and a paper straw in front, and a cold coffee dusted with brown powder behind it, with a hand holding a phone out of focus above

title: Malai chaap, on a stand
caption: Malai chaap at Punjab Grill.
note: Malai chaap hanging off a stand, which was fun to see. The food here is crazy good.
alt: Pieces of grilled malai chaap on two skewers hanging from a metal stand over a cast-iron tray of charred peppers, with a drizzle of white cream sauce, and a tall cold coffee behind

title: KitKat's own F1 car
caption: KitKat's Formula 1 car, in KitKat red.
note: KitKat showed off this F1 car, built around their own brand, and it looks so cool. The banner behind it says KitKat is an official partner of Formula 1.
alt: A bright red Formula 1 style car on a display stage, with the KitKat logo and the words Have a break along its nose and sides, in front of a backdrop of a race track and a red banner reading Official Partner of Formula 1, with rope barriers and staff in red shirts at the left

title: A fancy dinner
caption: Dinner at Skyhouse Bar & Kitchen.
note: A fancy dinner after the movies, on a good day at my cousin's in Noida. The food is a 4.5.
alt: A baked dish with a browned, cheesy top and vegetables in a dark restaurant, with a knife and fork resting on its edge

title: Drinks with a cherry on top
caption: Drinks at Skyhouse.
note: Skyhouse is so good, and so is the ambience.
alt: A stemmed glass of pale orange drink with a cherry on a pick and a fan of sliced apple, next to a bright orange drink with a lime garnish and a red drink behind, in a dim bar with warm lights

title: Inside Skyhouse
caption: Inside Skyhouse Bar & Kitchen.
alt: The ceiling and bar of a dark venue: beams and ducts lit blue, clusters of glowing glass cubes hanging at the left, two small Indian flags above a black espresso machine, and shelves of bottles lit amber at the right, over a wooden panel with a warm strip of light
note: A good day, and Skyhouse was a big part of it. The ambience is great and the food is also good.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
caption: On the big screen.
note: We went to watch movies after a day at my cousin's in Noida, and this title lit up the screen.
alt: The Marvel Studios title card for Spider-Man: Brand New Day glowing in red, blue and yellow on a dark cinema screen, tilted in the frame

title: The langur that wasn't
caption: A langur that turned out to be a cutout.
note: A langur, some way off, that never moved. I zoomed in with my phone, and it was a kind of scarecrow. We all laughed so much.
alt: What looks at first like a grey langur sitting upright in front of a yellow-framed wire mesh, next to a large tree trunk; it is actually a cutout scarecrow, photographed zoomed in

title: Brutality
caption: Sub-Zero wins, flawlessly.
note: Me at home on the PS5, playing Mortal Kombat and hitting a brutality.
alt: A blurred PS5 controller in the foreground and a wall-mounted TV behind it showing the Mortal Kombat Brutality screen, with Sub-Zero holding two ice axes and the words Sub-Zero wins

title: Golden clouds
caption: A sky of golden clouds.
alt: A sunset sky with a golden-lit cumulus tower rising from a bank of peach clouds at the bottom, under long streaks of grey and blue cloud
note: I stopped just to watch the clouds turn gold.

title: The moon through the clouds
caption: The moon, glowing through a patch of clouds.
alt: The moon as a bright disc behind thin clouds that glow peach and pale rainbow colours against dark blue clouds, with the silhouettes of tree branches at the right and bottom
note: The moon with peach and rainbow colours in the cloud around it. I could not stop looking.

title: The Parvati, early
caption: The Parvati, early in the morning.
note: After the long drive from Jaipur, this was the first real look at the mountains, and the tiredness just left me.
alt: A wide view of the Parvati river rushing over a stony bed in a green valley, with a few wooden houses on the far hillside and steep, sunlit mountains behind, framed by trees on the right

title: Roses and pines
caption: Roses at the camp, with the pine forest behind.
alt: Two red roses in the foreground, in focus, with a pine forest and rocky ridge in soft focus behind and a clear blue sky above
note: I did not expect roses up here. Red against all that green, and I kept looking back at them.

title: Sitting with the river
caption: Sitting on a boulder in the middle of the Parvati.
alt: A person in a green shirt and black cap sitting on a pale boulder in the middle of a fast mountain river, looking away to the side, with a pine-covered slope behind
note: I could have stayed on that rock all evening. The river was loud and cold, and I did not mind one bit.

title: Arms out
caption: Arms out on the biggest boulder in the river.
alt: A person in a pale green shirt standing on a large grey boulder in a river, arms stretched out to the sides, with a pine-covered hillside behind and a soft, grainy, faded colour grade
note: Arms wide open, feeling like the whole river belonged to us.

title: A stack of stones
caption: A small stack of river stones on the bank.
alt: A stack of smooth river stones balanced on a boulder, with the Parvati river rushing past out of focus and a pine forest on the hillside behind
note: Somebody had balanced these by the water. I stood there a while, just listening to the river.

title: Among the pines
caption: Pine trunks and a floor of needles, in the last of the evening light.
alt: Tall pine trunks with rough red-brown bark in the foreground of a forest clearing, a carpet of pine needles underfoot, golden light on a mountainside and a stone-built guesthouse among the trees on the right
note: Soft needles underfoot and the smell of pine everywhere. A quiet few minutes before it got dark.

title: Down the valley
caption: A gap in the pines with the valley below.
alt: A clearing among tall pines with a steep mountain slope on the left and a gap between the trees showing the valley opening into hazy golden light in the distance, and the river just visible below at the left
note: Pines on one side and the whole valley opening up below. I wanted to keep looking.

title: The bike, the river, the sun
caption: A Royal Enfield on the riverbank, with the sun going down.
alt: A cream and black Royal Enfield motorcycle parked on a sandy riverbank in the foreground, with a wide braided river, a few people walking on the stones, a dark pine forest and the sun flaring over a mountain ridge in the background
note: Everything turned warm and slow as the sun went down behind the river. I was so happy to be on this road.

title: A roadside stop at dusk
caption: Leaning on the crash barrier, mountains behind.
alt: A smiling person in a black top, jeans and a checked scarf leaning on a yellow and black crash barrier at the roadside, with a forested mountain slope and a thin waterfall behind in a hazy, grainy blue-green grade
note: A quick stop on the roadside as the mountains went dark behind us. A good, easy evening.

title: A bottle on the table
caption: A bottle of Jägermeister, on the trip.
alt: A hand holding up a large bottle of Jägermeister, label facing the camera, in a wood-panelled room with a pink chair and tables blurred behind
note: Just a silly photo on the road, because we were having such a good time.

title: Shiva, at the temple
caption: Shiva in front of the temple spire at Manikaran.
note: The temple and the gurdwara stand side by side here, and the whole town felt calm and holy.
alt: A dark relief statue of Shiva with matted hair, rudraksha beads and a cobra, holding a long trident with a damaru, set against a stone wall in front of a tiled temple spire, with a pink flower and coins left at the base

title: Flags over the gorge
caption: Strings of coloured flags across the Parvati gorge.
alt: Lines of small coloured flags strung high across a narrow river gorge between a white multi-storey building with a Santpura sign on the left and an arched, weathered building on the right, with green mountains and a rocky stream below
note: Colour everywhere above the gorge. I kept looking up.

title: Manikaran, on the Parvati
caption: Manikaran, stacked up one side of the gorge.
note: Hot springs in a cold mountain town felt like the best kind of surprise.
alt: The town of Manikaran climbing the left bank of the Parvati river, its guesthouses stacked on the hillside above a temple with a railing, with the river tumbling over boulders in the centre and orange-stained water running down the retaining wall at the bottom left

title: Divine vibes in Manikaran
caption: Divine vibes in Manikaran.
alt: A person in a black cap and black top at an ornate white railing, one hand on their head and their face hidden behind the other, with rows of coloured flags overhead, mountains behind and the text DIVINE VIBES IN MANIKARAN with an Om symbol across the sky
note: That is exactly how it felt.

title: The tricolour at Sissu
caption: The Indian flag in front of the snow peaks of Lahaul.
note: The tricolour flying against all that snow felt special. I was proud to see it there.
alt: The Indian flag flying from a pole on a dry mountainside, with snow-streaked mountains rising behind it and a deep blue sky full of white clouds above

title: The Sissu waterfall
caption: The waterfall at Sissu, still fed by the snow.
note: It was still running full from the snow. I stood and watched it for a long time.
alt: A thin white waterfall dropping down a dark cliff face into a spray-filled gorge, with tongues of snow and green scrub on the slopes above and bright green meadow either side of the base, where tiny figures stand

title: Prayer flags over Jispa
caption: Prayer flags over Karma Cottage & Camp in Jispa.
note: We spent the night here. It was cold, but all those flags made it feel cheerful.
alt: Lines of tattered prayer flags in blue, white, red, green and yellow crossing a bright blue sky above red-roofed cottages, an orange restaurant and a Karma Cottage & Camp, Jispa sign, with snow-topped peaks and a steep brown mountain behind

title: Last light on the peaks
caption: The last of the sun on the mountains above Jispa.
alt: A dark triangular mountain in shadow with the ridge behind it lit orange by the setting sun, snow in the gullies and white clouds drifting over a deep blue sky
note: The sun was almost gone and the peaks turned orange for one minute. I was tired and so happy.

title: Blue hour in Jispa
caption: Blue hour over the rooftops of Jispa.
alt: A jagged snow-covered peak wrapped in cloud with a pink glow on its summit, above the rooftops of a few concrete and tin-roofed guesthouses in the cool blue light after sunset
note: The cold came in fast after sunset, and I was glad to be inside for the night.

title: Morning in Jispa
caption: Morning light on the big slanted rock face above Jispa.
alt: A huge slanted rock face of layered grey and rust stone under a clear blue sky, with snowy peaks behind it, a pale riverbed and meadow in the foreground
note: Our last morning here, and I did not want to leave this place.

title: Snow peaks, on the way up
caption: The first big snow peaks on the road to Shinku La.
alt: A ridge of sharp white snow peaks under heavy grey cloud, with a dark, snow-streaked mountain in the foreground at the right
place: On the road to Shinku La
note: The mountains suddenly got huge. I stopped talking and just looked.

title: A seat on the guardrail
caption: Sitting on the guardrail, looking up the valley.
alt: A person in a black hoodie, maroon top and light jeans sitting on a metal crash barrier at the roadside and looking to the left, with rubble in the foreground and a valley of snow-dusted mountains under a flat white sky behind
place: On the road to Shinku La
note: The air was thin and cold. I sat there for a while, looking up the valley, and felt very small.

title: Snowing on the Shinku La road
caption: Snow falling at the top of the road.

place: On the road to Shinku La

title: Morning in the valley
caption: The Parvati valley, early on 17 May.

title: At the camp
caption: Outside the tent we stayed in at Kasol.

title: Rapids

title: The hot spring

title: Mirror selfie

title: In the cream shirt
caption: Another mirror selfie, in the shirt from the temple day.

title: All of us
caption: The whole group in the courtyard on the first morning.

title: A fresh tilak

title: So many people
caption: The road towards Ram Ghat on the long weekend.
note: We went on a long weekend, and there was so much crowd. At 10:23 in the morning the whole road was one slow stream of people, and this was only the first day.
alt: A very dense crowd filling a street, seen from under a canvas awning between two wooden poles, with tents, power lines and a blue direction sign above it, and a child in a teal jacket sitting on someone's shoulders in the foreground

title: A rose
caption: A red rose in hand, on the way to the temple.
note: I took a rose with me into the line. It was a long wait, but I did not mind.
alt: A hand holding a red rose with a green leaf, over a stone floor

title: The darshan line
caption: Inside the temple, in the line for darshan.
note: Shoulder to shoulder, slowly moving, everyone with the same wish. It felt good to be part of it.
alt: A tightly packed line of people moving through a temple hall with a carved wooden ceiling, a screen showing the lingam above them and a clock on the wall

title: Mahakaleshwar
caption: The Mahakaleshwar temple, from the courtyard.
note: After all that waiting in the line, seeing the spire up close felt wonderful.
alt: The orange, tiered spire of the Mahakaleshwar temple rising above a pillared hall of carved grey stone, with people standing between the pillars

title: In the courtyard
caption: At the temple, with the spire behind us.
note: Done with the line, and just happy to stand in front of the temple together.
alt: A woman in a pink cardigan with a yellow shawl and a young man in a cream shirt standing together in a courtyard, with the orange spire and dark stone walls of the temple behind them

title: Hands together
caption: Hands together in the temple courtyard.
note: A quiet minute of prayer in the courtyard.
alt: A young man in sunglasses with his palms together in a temple courtyard, with the orange spire behind him and a cream-coloured dome at the right

title: The whole complex
caption: The temple complex and the crowd outside it.
note: So many people, and still more arriving. Everyone wants to be here.
alt: A wide view of the temple complex under a grey sky, with cream-coloured shrines and domes, an open hall and a large crowd in front

title: Lit up green
caption: The banyan trees at Siddhavat, lit green at night.
note: The trees glowing green in the dark looked almost unreal.
alt: Two large banyan trees lit bright green at night against a hazy blue sky, with a red-roofed open pavilion and umbrellas beneath them

title: The goddess at the ghat
caption: An idol decorated with marigolds, at the ghat.
note: Everyone crowded in to photograph her, and the marigolds made the whole ghat glow.
alt: A goddess idol in red clothes and a crown, seated between tall columns of marigold garlands at night, with two people in the foreground raising their phones to photograph her

title: On the steps
caption: All of us on the ghat steps at night.
note: We sat on the steps with the diyas floating behind us, all tired and smiling.
alt: Six people sitting and standing on stone ghat steps at night, smiling for a selfie, with marigold flowers floating on the dark water behind them

title: A prayer at the river
caption: Hands together on the ghat by the Shipra.
note: A quiet minute by the river after all the noise of the day.
alt: A young man in a dark sweater with his palms together on a ghat at night, with strings of lights and orange hangings above and flowers floating on the water behind

title: The bar ka ped
caption: Siddhavat, the banyan that Mata Parvati is said to have planted.
note: I stood under the bar ka ped for a while. It is a very old tree, and you can feel that.
alt: The branches of a banyan tree lit bright green at night, hanging over an old stone wall and a metal railing, with the dark river and its far bank below

title: Night at the ghat
caption: The goddess, the marigolds and the crowd at the ghat.
note: I wanted to keep the noise and the lights of this night.
alt: A goddess idol in red under an arch of marigold garlands at night, with people gathered around her and orange and blue balloons hanging above

title: Kaal Bhairav
caption: The gate of the Kaal Bhairav temple at night.
note: The gate lit up in the dark. I was a little nervous and very excited to go in.
alt: The yellow sandstone gate of the Shri Kaal Bhairav Mandir lit up at night, with a crowd climbing the steps to its arched doorway

title: With the offering
caption: With the offering basket at Kaal Bhairav.
note: Holding the offering and waiting for my turn, a little nervous.
alt: A young man in a dark sweater holding a basket of offerings beside a railing woven with colourful threads, with the lit temple gate behind him

title: Up the steps
caption: The line climbing the steps to the gate.
note: Slowly up the steps with everyone, one step at a time.
alt: A crowd climbing the steps to the Kaal Bhairav gate at night, seen from behind, with a phone held up in the middle and threads hanging on the railings on both sides

title: A tower of lamps
caption: A tower of lamps at Kaal Bhairav, lit with diyas.
note: All those tiny flames in the dark made me stop and stare.
alt: A tall, tiered stone lamp tower at night, its rows of small niches holding lit diyas, in front of an orange-lit building

title: The inner queue
caption: The queue at the entrance of the inner shrine.
note: So tightly packed that I could hardly move, but nobody seemed to mind.
alt: A packed queue of people waiting at the orange-painted entrance of the temple's inner shrine at night, under a tin roof, with a phone raised at the right

title: Threads and charms
caption: Charms and offerings tied up with coloured thread.
note: Threads and wishes left by everyone who came before us.
alt: Rows of small hanging charms and offerings tied with colourful threads, with small dark faces, yellow lemons and pine cones, against green netting

title: The lane at night
caption: A packed lane at night, with people going both ways.
note: A packed lane at night, and I loved how alive it felt.
alt: A crowded lane at night under a metal roof, with people walking in both directions and market lights ahead
place: On the way to Kaal Bhairav

title: Into the gate
caption: In the line, going in through the Kaal Bhairav gate.
note: Almost at the gate, carried along by the crowd.
alt: A tight crowd moving towards the lit gate of the Shri Kaal Bhairav Mandir at night, with coloured threads hanging at the right

title: By the Narmada
caption: A stop at the Narmada on the way to Omkareshwar.
note: A calm stop by a wide river, after the noise of the road and the crowd.
alt: Four people standing together on a sandy riverbank, with a wide river and a long bridge behind them

title: A fair by the water
caption: A small fair on the bank, with a Ferris wheel.
note: A small fair on the bank, with a Ferris wheel. It made the afternoon feel like a holiday.
alt: A wide river with a long bridge in the distance, and a small fair on the bank with a Ferris wheel, stalls and tents

title: In the Narmada
caption: In the water, with the Narmada all around.
note: This is me in the river, near Omkareshwar. The river is the Narmada, and the water felt wonderful.
alt: A smiling young man with wet hair and wet shoulders in a wide river, with flat banks and a hazy sky behind him

title: All of us in one auto
caption: Everyone squeezed into a single auto.
note: The crowd was so heavy that all of us had to sit inside one single auto: my parents, my bhua and the other family, all packed in. I took this selfie.
alt: Many people squeezed into the back of an auto-rickshaw under an orange patterned roof, faces close together, one in sunglasses smiling widely at the front

title: The lane down to the river
caption: Walking down the lane to the ghat.
note: Everyone walking the same way, down towards the river. I loved the busy, happy feel of it.
alt: A narrow lane lined with shops and a balcony under a large tree, with people walking down it in the afternoon

title: Omkareshwar
caption: The ghats and the temples on the hill, across the Narmada.
note: This was the view I had been waiting for: the ghats and the temples on the hill, right across the Narmada.
alt: The ghats of Omkareshwar seen across the river, with terraces of orange buildings and temples climbing a hillside and boats and a crowd at the water's edge

title: Dusk
caption: Dusk over the ghats and the bridge.
note: The light turned soft and gold, and everything slowed down for a minute.
alt: Dusk over Omkareshwar, with a bridge, old stone buildings and a mobile tower on the far bank under a hazy yellow sky

title: After dark
caption: Omkareshwar's bridges and ghats, lit up at night.
note: Everything lit up and reflected in the Narmada. I did not want to leave.
alt: Omkareshwar at night, with brightly lit bridges, a crowd at the water and strings of lights reflected in the dark river

title: In the temple lane
caption: The group in the lane to the temple.
note: The last photograph of the day. I had a fresh tilak on by then, and I was tired and happy.
alt: A group of six people standing in a narrow temple lane lined with shops, the young man at the front, in a green shirt with a tilak, holding the camera for a selfie

title: Boats at the ghat
caption: The ghat at Omkareshwar, with the boats and the crowd.
note: The boats waiting at the ghat and the old temples climbing the hill behind them. I felt tiny, in a good way.
alt: A wide view of the Omkareshwar ghat with a crowd at the water's edge, boats, and old buildings and temples on the hills

title: The market lane
caption: The market lane on the way to the temple.
note: The lane was so crowded that we could only move with the crowd, in the same direction as everyone else.
alt: A crowded market lane seen from behind the crowd, with shops, yellow awnings and Hindi signboards on both sides

title: Along the railing
caption: The queue along the railing at the ghat.
note: Everyone queued along the railing while the bridge glowed in the distance.
alt: A queue of people standing behind a railing along the ghat, with a suspension bridge in the distance under a dusty sky

title: Another banyan
caption: A banyan with a small shrine at its roots.
note: Another big old banyan, with a small shrine tucked in at the bottom that is easy to miss.
alt: A banyan tree with hanging roots, saffron flags tied to it and a small orange-painted shrine at its base, beside a paved walkway

title: Shiva under the serpent
caption: Shiva seated on coils beneath a many-hooded serpent.
note: I stood and looked up at him for a long time.
alt: A pale statue of Shiva seated in meditation on three coils of a snake, beneath a spread of many cobra hoods, in a landscaped garden

title: Posing
caption: Two of us in front of the serpent statue.
note: Posing in front of the serpent on our last morning, a little sad that it was ending.
alt: A woman in a yellow outfit and sunglasses and a man in a brown sweater and sunglasses posing together, with the many-hooded serpent statue behind them

title: A rest in the shade
caption: A rest on the curved benches.
note: A short rest in the shade. The corridor is long, and we needed it.
alt: Four people sitting on a curved wooden bench in a slatted shelter, one in a brown shirt and sunglasses holding the camera for a selfie

title: In profile
caption: Looking out from the benches.
note: Looking away from the camera, just thinking.
alt: A young man in sunglasses and a brown shirt looking away to the side, in front of a curved wooden slatted screen

title: Closer
caption: A closer one, on the same bench.
note: You can see the whole shelter in my sunglasses.
alt: A close portrait of a young man in sunglasses and a brown ribbed polo shirt, looking away to the right, in front of wooden slats and green leaves, with a curved slatted ceiling reflected in the lenses

title: Hanuman
caption: In front of the Hanuman statue at Mahakal Lok.
note: Standing in front of Hanuman Ji, with fresh flowers at his feet.
alt: A young man in sunglasses and a brown shirt standing in front of a large pale statue of Hanuman seated with a raised hand, with flowers at its base and an iron railing around it

title: Shiva, Nandi and the lion
caption: A sculpture group at Mahakal Lok.
note: The last photo of the set, and the one I liked best: Shiva with his arms raised, Nandi and the lion.
alt: A group of pinkish-brown statues: a tall figure of Shiva with raised arms and a small dancing figure on his head, a kneeling figure at the left, a standing figure at the right, and a bull and a lion at the base

title: Bianca al Formaggio
caption: Bianca al Formaggio pizza and a berry mojito at Brunatos.
note: I can't forget how this tastes yet. The cheese, the bake, everything about the pizza is so good, and the mojito is tasty and refreshing.
alt: A round cheese pizza with strips of red pepper and sliced green jalapeños on a wooden paddle over printed paper, one slice cut onto a white plate at the left, beside a tall stemmed glass of orange-red mojito with a green striped paper straw, on a white marble table

title: The berry mojito
caption: The all fruit and berries mojito at Brunatos.
note: So tasty and so refreshing.
alt: A selfie of a bearded man in a brown ribbed polo shirt holding a large round glass of orange-red mojito with a green striped straw up to the camera, in a warm restaurant with a hanging woven lamp and plants along the ceiling

title: Inside Brunatos
caption: A look round Brunatos.
note: The ambience is quite good, modern and aesthetic.
alt: The inside of a bright restaurant: wooden chairs with green seats at white-topped tables in the foreground, a woven hanging lamp and small tags hanging from a dark slatted ceiling, and tall windows with plants at the back

title: Dumpling soup
caption: Dumpling soup at Bento B.
note: Very tasty, and authentic.
alt: A white bowl of clear broth with large dumplings, bok choy and carrot, black chopsticks dipping into the soup, on a wooden table with a woven placemat and a menu

title: Creamy miso ramen
caption: Creamy miso ramen at Bento B.
note: The noodles are very tasty and authentic.
alt: A wide speckled bowl of orange-red broth topped with two fried eggs with sesame seeds, spring onion and a sheet of dark nori, on a wooden table with woven placemats, a water glass and chopsticks beyond

title: Katsu curry bento box
caption: The Japanese katsu curry bento box at Bento B, with the ramen beside it.
note: The bento box is a 5/5.
alt: A table seen from above: a black bento box of small bowls of pickles, salad, avocado and kimchi beside a white tray of rice, fritters and watermelon, a bowl of dark curry, two red drinks, chopsticks on a rest, and a bowl of ramen with two fried eggs at the right

title: Japanese cheesecake
caption: Japanese cheesecake at Bento B.
note: So soft and so tasty, mouth-watering. Must try.
alt: A thick wedge of golden, airy Japanese cheesecake with a spoonful of red berry sauce on top, on a speckled plate with two spoons, on a wooden table with woven placemats and a red napkin

title: Opening the bento box
caption: The bento box arriving wrapped in cloth at Bento B.
note: Bento B is right beside the Crossword bookstore, so I went into the store first, had something to read for a while, and then enjoyed the meal.
alt: An opened bento box on a wooden table: a white tray of rice, fritters and watermelon beside a black box of small bowls, a hand lifting the black lid away at the top, and a red drink at the lower right

title: Flowers round a mirror
caption: Flowers round a window mirror, at a market in Agra.
note: A random click at a market near Shah Market.
alt: Pink and white roses and blossoms climbing a wall and arching over a window-shaped mirror, lit warmly, with a person holding a phone reflected in the glass, beside a stair railing

title: Teal and yellow chairs
caption: Teal and yellow chairs by a counter, at a market in Agra.
note: A random click near Shah Market.
alt: Inside a small café: teal and yellow wire chairs with floral cushions at wooden tables, a slatted wooden divider with plants and pink flowers, and a counter at the back under lit food pictures, with staff at work

title: A waffle under chocolate
caption: A waffle at Belgian Waffle, near Shah Market in Agra.
note: A waffle I tried at Belgian Waffle.
alt: A yellow takeaway box holding a waffle buried under chocolate sauce, crushed nuts, white and dark sprinkles and ice cream, with two striped wafer rolls standing on top

title: The Himalaya from the plane
caption: The snow range from the window.
note: I pressed my face to the window for most of the flight. The mountains went on and on above the clouds.
alt: A line of snow-covered Himalayan peaks along the horizon under a deep blue sky and a thin layer of cloud, seen from a plane window

title: The range, a minute later
caption: The same snow range, wider.
note: I could not look away. Peak after peak after peak.
alt: Snow-capped peaks stretched along the horizon under a pale blue sky, with a band of cloud below them

title: A city from the window
caption: A city of dense buildings under haze, as the plane came down.
note: Coming down into Kathmandu, a little hazy, a little nervous and mostly excited. My phone had lost its location in the air, so there is no pin on this one.
alt: A dense city of low buildings seen from the air under a brown haze, with a tall pale tower rising in the distance

title: Into Thamel
caption: A gateway and a big tree on a quiet Thamel lane.
note: Our first afternoon in Kathmandu, and Thamel already felt busy and alive.
alt: A red-framed gateway leading to a paved courtyard with a large bare tree, a small shrine umbrella at the left and tall brick buildings around

title: A shrine at Asan
caption: A pagoda-roofed shrine lit up at night at Asan Tol.
note: A lit-up shrine in the middle of the night. We were tired, but I did not want to go back yet.
alt: A small pagoda-roofed shrine with gilded roofs behind a red iron cage, strung with lights, on a paved street at night, with a motorbike at the left and power lines overhead

title: The little stupa
caption: A small white stupa at the corner of a night street.
note: A tiny white stupa on a corner, easy to miss, and it made the night feel peaceful.
alt: A small white stupa with a gold spire behind a low fence at the corner of a street at night, beside a tall street lamp, with red-brick buildings and power lines

title: A late dinner
caption: Dumplings in a spicy soup and fried rice, in Thamel.
note: Hot, spicy dumpling soup well after midnight. It was exactly what we needed.
alt: Overhead view of a bowl of dumplings in an orange spicy soup and a plate of fried rice with a small bowl of yellow sauce, on a wooden table

title: Brunch by the window
caption: A smile over brunch at a bright table.
note: A slow, happy brunch on the second day, with the whole trip still ahead of us.
alt: A smiling man in a black coat and a grey scarf at a cafe table by a bright window, with a bowl in front of him

title: Looking up
caption: A tall atrium hung with prayer flags, seen from below.
note: I stood in the middle and looked up. Prayer flags all the way to the sky.
alt: Looking up a tall atrium of a building with balconies and strings of prayer flags to a skylight, with a dark shoulder in the foreground

title: The painting shop
caption: A shop packed with paintings of mountains and mandalas.
note: I could have spent hours in here. Paintings on every wall and on every bit of floor.
alt: A small shop crowded with framed paintings of mountain landscapes and mandalas, stacked on the floor and hung on every wall

title: Flowers and red tassels
caption: A restaurant entrance hung with red tassels and plants.
note: Every doorway in Thamel is pretty like this, and I kept stopping to look.
alt: The entrance of a restaurant hung with red and green tassels and purple hanging plants, over a dark brick wall with a name sign

title: A Thamel lane
caption: A narrow lane of shops and cafes under prayer flags.
note: A quiet lane in the afternoon, before the evening crowd arrived.
alt: A narrow pedestrian lane lined with shops and cafes under strings of prayer flags, almost empty in daylight

title: The temple gateway
caption: The painted gateway of Pashupatinath, with its sign in Nepali.
note: Reading the sign made it real: we were at Pashupatinath.
alt: The painted entrance gateway of Pashupatinath Temple, a blue Shiva in the central panel with a gold OM above and a sign in Nepali below, with a yellow shrine and a building behind

title: Namaste at the gate
caption: Palms together in front of the gateway.
note: Barefoot on the cold stones, feeling very small and very glad to be here.
alt: A man in a grey scarf with palms pressed together in front of the painted gateway, barefoot on the stones, with other visitors walking past

title: The pigeons
caption: Hundreds of pigeons on the plaza at Pashupatinath.
note: Hundreds of pigeons lifting off at once. I just stood there and let the wings go by.
alt: Hundreds of pigeons on a sunlit stone square with old brick buildings behind

title: A painted sadhu
caption: A mural of a sadhu with a trident, on a black brick wall.
note: This painted sadhu on the wall stopped me: red behind him and skulls at his feet.
alt: A mural on a black brick wall of a bearded sadhu seated cross-legged with a trident, skulls at his feet, against a red wall

title: Boudhanath at dusk
caption: The gold spire and the painted eyes, at dusk.
note: Looking down at us in the last light, the eyes made me feel completely calm.
alt: The gold spire of Boudhanath stupa with the painted eyes of the Buddha and strings of prayer flags above the white dome, against a glowing evening sky

title: Round the stupa
caption: People walking the circle round Boudhanath at dusk.
note: Everyone walking round together, slowly, in the same direction. It was peaceful just to join in.
alt: A crowded street of shops and lights at dusk with people in winter clothes walking in the same direction, a woman in a cream coat and black jacket at the centre

title: Leaving the valley
caption: Layers of blue hills in the afternoon haze.
note: Leaving Kathmandu behind, with the hills fading into blue haze.
alt: Layers of blue hills fading into afternoon haze, seen over tree-covered slopes from the road

title: Hills from the road
caption: A wide view of layered hills and a village on a slope.
note: Hill after hill. I could have watched them go by all day.
alt: A wide view of layered hills with a small village on the slope, in warm haze

title: The bull
caption: A bull in an orange cloth, with garlands.
note: A bull in an orange cloth, covered in garlands, right at the entrance.
alt: A brown bull figure draped in an orange cloth printed with Nepali text, with garlands and offerings around it

title: The shrine in the cave
caption: A shrine deep in the cave, under a hanging bell.
note: Deeper in, a small shrine under a bell, quiet and dark.
alt: A shrine inside a dim cave: a dark figure and a lingam under a hanging bell, surrounded by offerings and fencing

title: In the cave
caption: A smile in front of a rough cave wall.
note: Wet, dim and warmer than outside. I was a little nervous and a little thrilled.
alt: A man in a grey scarf and jacket smiling in front of a rough cave wall lit from the side

title: Water in the cave
caption: White water rushing through a narrow gap in dark rock.
note: The water roars through the gap in the rock. I could feel it in my chest.
alt: A narrow gap in dark rock with white water rushing through it

title: Devi's Fall
caption: A narrow waterfall dropping into a rock gorge.
note: The river just vanishes into the earth. I stood there for a long time, trying to work out where the water goes.
alt: A narrow waterfall dropping into a rock gorge lined with green and orange trees, seen from above

title: Devi's Fall, moving
caption: The fall dropping into the gorge.
note: I wanted the sound as much as the sight.
alt: A waterfall plunging down a narrow rock gorge, with ferns and bushes at the sides

title: On the bridge
caption: A footbridge with blue railings above the gorge.
note: Standing on the bridge with the gorge right under my feet.
alt: A man in sunglasses and a grey scarf on a footbridge with blue railings, with green forest behind

title: A golden Buddha
caption: A small gold Buddha behind bars, with red garlands.
note: A tiny gold Buddha behind bars, easy to walk past, and I am glad I did not.
alt: A small gold Buddha statue with red garlands, seated inside a metal cage, with flowers beyond

title: On the way up
caption: Two of us in the back of a vehicle, one making a peace sign.
note: Squeezed in the back on the way up, and laughing about it.
alt: A selfie of two men in a vehicle, one in a brown jacket making a peace sign and one in a grey scarf, with trees through the window

title: A tree on the ridge
caption: A tree on a rocky outcrop with someone sitting under it.
note: A quiet stop on the way up, with a lone tree to sit under.
alt: A tree on a rocky outcrop with a person sitting beneath it, a valley and mist beyond

title: The valley and the lake
caption: A wide valley with a blue lake in the distance.
note: The whole valley and the lake far below. It made me go quiet.
alt: A wide valley with a blue lake in the distance under a blue sky and scattered clouds, with brown ridges in the foreground

title: The valley, wider
caption: A hazy plain between green ridges.
note: I turned a little and it was just as good the other way.
alt: A wide valley with a hazy plain and green ridges under a blue sky with white clouds

title: At the railing
caption: A man in a grey scarf at a viewpoint railing.
note: Leaning on the railing, taking it all in.
alt: A man in a grey scarf leaning on a black railing at a viewpoint, with a stone gatepost and a blue sky behind him

title: Shiva at Pumdikot
caption: A giant blue Shiva, seated on a tiger skin, above a white dome.

alt: A giant blue statue of Shiva seated on a tiger skin, one hand raised, on top of a white domed building, under a blue sky

title: At the foot of the statue
caption: Palms together in front of the white dome.
note: I folded my hands at the bottom of the steps and felt very small next to him.
alt: A man with palms together standing in front of the white dome beneath the blue Shiva statue

title: Ridges in the haze
caption: Layers of ridges fading into warm mist.
note: The haze made every ridge a softer shade than the one in front of it.
alt: Layers of hazy ridges fading into warm golden mist

title: The World Peace Pagoda
caption: The white pagoda with its gold niche and a flight of steps.
note: A bright white pagoda on top of a hill, and so peaceful after all the climbing.
alt: The white domed World Peace Pagoda with a gold Buddha niche in its side and a flight of steps leading up to it, under a blue sky

title: Two of us
caption: Two friends in grey scarves, with the valley behind.
note: Two of us at the foot of the pagoda, happy to have made it up.
alt: Two men in grey scarves standing close together on a white terrace with a hazy view over the valley behind them

title: In front of the Buddha
caption: A man in a scarf in front of a golden Buddha niche.

alt: A man in a grey scarf standing before a gold Buddha figure in a niche with golden carved columns and Japanese characters

title: Red leaves
caption: A bush of red leaves and blue flowers in the garden.

alt: A bush of deep red leaves among yellow foliage and small blue flowers in a hillside garden

title: A restaurant on the trail
caption: A hall with a wood ceiling and big windows over the hills.

alt: A restaurant with a wood-beamed ceiling, big windows, sofas and chairs, with the hills beyond

title: Inside Mahendra Cave
caption: A rough cave wall, dabbed red with powder.

title: Red rock
caption: Cave rock dyed red by offerings.

title: The Mahendra Cave sign
caption: A big sign over a long flight of steps.

title: Outside the cave
caption: A group standing under a shelter by a yellow hut in the woods.

title: Terraces in the woods
caption: A stone viewing terrace among tall trees.

title: Bats on the ceiling

title: Binoculars
caption: Two of us with our hands as binoculars, in the Bat Cave.
